title: BNY unveils blockchain-based transfer agency service
snippet: BNY has launched a digital version of its transfer agency business, tapping blockchain technology for its record keeping.

title: Visa CEO sidesteps labeling Open USD a challenger to Tether and USDC: 'Our role is not to pick winners'
message_html: Visa CEO sidesteps labeling Open USD a challenger to Tether and USDC: 'Our role is not to pick winners' ...
snippet: The payment giant will "remain multi-coin, multi-chain" and "not to pick winners" as stablecoins are poised to proliferate.
